0022600188.text: The Golden State Warriors (5-3, on a five-game winning streak and 3-1 at home) host the Miami Heat (2-5, coming off a loss) in this game, the Warriors' ninth of the season. Golden State sits 2nd in the Pacific, one game back, and 7th in the West, while Miami is 4th in the Southeast, two games back, and 10th in the East. The Warriors are without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Al Horford (rest), Brandon Williams (quadriceps bruise), and Gui Santos (knee) are listed as day-to-day. The two teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting on January 19, 2026, in San Francisco, where the Warriors won 135-112.
